For a solar generator kit under $700, I'd prioritize a LiFePO4 battery, at least 500Wh of capacity, a 100W–200W solar panel, and a pure sine wave inverter.

My top brands to consider are EcoFlow, BLUETTI, Jackery, and Anker SOLIX. The best choice depends on whether you're using it for power outages, camping, or running appliances.

One important distinction: a solar generator kit should include both the portable power station and solar panels. Some attractive advertised prices cover only the battery unit.

A 200W solar panel might generate around 500–800Wh on a reasonably sunny day, depending on conditions. A 100W panel produces roughly half that.

My pick

I'd buy the EcoFlow DELTA 3 Classic + 200W kit for $659, provided the two rigid panels work for your setup. It offers stronger solar recharging value than the BLUETTI 100W bundle.
